_notes.rule: Ceilings only ratchet down. A PR that raises one names the reason here, under set, beside that group.
_notes.units: kB of 1000 bytes, raw (not gzip) sizes in dist/ after npx vite build; checked by npm run budget (scripts/bundle-budget.mjs).
_notes.groups: A named key groups chunks in dist/assets (including nested directories) by filename prefix with its eight-character hash dropped. Every remaining *.js and *.css file counts exactly once under other chunks, even without a recognised hash. Precache remains every file listed inside dist/sw.js. Precache is also checked as two groups of the same manifest entries, each counted once (CO-1): precache data/ is every entry under data/ (the snapshots Pages refreshes with npm run snapshots and PR CI builds as committed), precache code is every other entry; precache stays as their total.
